svg.text: variance ratio of the pooled statistic
post hoc experiment; grid S2 sits at 1.0
left axis 0-20%, right axis 0-100%; every dot is a pooled test
Small dots: 18 grid cells at 500 replicates. Horizontal bars: the main configuration at 1,000 replicates.
95% Monte Carlo intervals on the cell rates are about +/-0.1 points and are not drawn.
